0.why: PolyMuter16Plus.cpp takes getChannels() from this jack as the output count and reads getVoltage(c) per channel
PolyMuter16Plus.cpp:846 region sets the channel count with setChannels() and writes setVoltage(value, c) per channel

comment: Each mute button is a four-position parameter (PolyMuter16Plus.cpp:219-234): Unmuted, Solo, Solo/Mute, Muted, which is how one button carries both states. The first button's value list names position 2 'Solo' where the other fifteen name it 'Solo/Mute'. Unlike the non-plus version there is no 'exclude -10v chans too' item. The IN and OUT jacks carry whatever is patched, so they get no family.
